name: Haruna Riku
source: The main character in AstralAir. Riku is an Elfin (people who can use psychic abilities) along with [url=/c17995]Hinata[/url] and [url=/c17038]Rinne[/url], and is a part of the organization run by [url=/c17042]Ochiba’s[/url] father, [url=https://vndb.org/c21058]Daiki[/url]. As a child, he lived in an orphanage in Tsukigasaki alongside Rinne. During that time he often played with a girl named [url=/c16435]Yuuki[/url], making snowmen and having snowball fights. Years later, he returns again to Tsukigasaki to guard Ochiba and [url=/c20285]Hazuki[/url], living in their house with them.
